title: The CMS add-on (GSoC 2013)
description: The 2013 CMS add-on from the Student Hall of Fame, which the zap-extensions history shows as the cmss add-on (also named wafp), from September 2013 to its removal in December 2020.

chapters.title: The project and the first commits
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists a CMS add-on (Abdelhadi Azouni) as a 2013 Summer GSoC project. The linked idea page calls the project "ZAP CMSS". The last commit to change CMSFingerprinter.java before the add-on was removed (2019-05-08, "Normalise format/style Java code") has a commented-out method whose comment reads "Use BlindElephant DB to fingerprint webapp". It reads joomla.xml, requests each listed path under a target URL, and compares the response checksum with the md5 values in that file to print versions. In zap-extensions the cmss directory (org/zaproxy/zap/extension/cmss) first appears in four commits dated 2013-09-14, whose subject lines are empty and whose author names are email addresses, so they are cited by SHA only. This story does not claim the commits' author from the Hall of Fame entry.

chapters.title: 2013 to 2018: build files and maintenance
chapters.text: "Updated build file for birtreport, cmss, jruby and wappalyser add-ons." is dated 2013-10-30. "Issue 1113 - Change add-on dir structure (help and resources)" is dated 2014-03-26, "added tests for CMSSUtils#checksum(byte[])" 2014-05-02, and "cmss: remove unnecessary call to finalize" 2018-06-29.

chapters.title: 2019 to 2020: relocated, then removed
chapters.text: "cmss: remove unused extension" is dated 2019-03-22 and "cmss: relocate to its own project" 2019-04-03. On 2020-12-16 a commit titled "wafp: Remove" is dated; its message body reads "Remove the wafp (cmss) project." There is no cmss add-on in the current dataset or tree.
